title: Node Health Checker
summary: Tests whether saved nodes are reachable by probing the host and port inside each share link (TCP connect, or a UDP probe for kcp, quic, hysteria and tuic links) and reports approximate latency in milliseconds. Results are only displayed and are not used by the balancer.

items.title: Check All Nodes
items.description: Tests every saved config and prints a reachable/total summary at the end.
items.usage_tip: Configs stored with enabled=false are skipped. UDP endpoints that ignore ICMP are reported as unknown instead of unreachable.

items.title: Check Selected Nodes
items.description: Lets you test only the node numbers you type instead of the whole list.
items.usage_tip: Enter numbers separated by spaces, for example 1 2 4.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Results are only displayed; no config is modified.
